budget_items.topic: Retention credit offsetting Van Pool costs (CARES Act)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Van Dyke said the company earned employee retention credits, part of which is a credit of a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: part is a credit amounting to $18,967.

budget_items.topic: Savings from a forbearance agreement on loans
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Van Dyke estimated the savings from a forbearance agreement at roughly a stated figure, and said the loans could not be put in forbearance.
budget_items.quote: mr. van dyke stated it would be roughly around $18,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Van Dyke said the company must buy new buses every five years and was buying several for other districts at a cost stated as over a figure.
budget_items.quote: we are in the process of buying several new buses for some other districts and that was over $30,000.

budget_items.quote: we make a 3% profit generally but we lost the athletics and field trips and this eats up our profit.
